title: Chorizo Fundido
description: Chef John's spicy and creamy baked dip is made with fresh chorizo, bell pepper, chiles, and three kinds of cheese. Serve with tortilla chips.
ingredients: 0.5 cup sliced green onions, white and lighter green parts (green parts reserved)

steps.text: Place chorizo, green onions, red bell pepper, poblano chilies, and jalapeno in a cold skillet. Turn heat to medium-high. As skillet comes up to temperature break up chorizo into very small pieces. Continue cooking until sausage is browned and peppers are barely cooked through, 4 to 6 minutes. Remove from heat. If sausage releases a lot of grease, mop up some with a paper towel.
Mix cream cheese, sausage mixture, Monterey Jack cheese, Cheddar cheese, and sour cream in a bowl. Transfer to a shallow, heat-proof baking dish.
Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler.
Broil on high until browned and bubbly, 5 or 6 minutes.

video.description: A meaty and cheesy dip that’s perfect for game season. Begin by cooking together chorizo sausage with red bell pepper, green onion, poblano chiles and jalapenos. Then mix the warm sausage mixture with cream cheese, sharp Cheddar and Monterey Jack cheese and broil! Nicely browned and tempting, with a topping of tomato and green onion, the only thing left to do is dig in with some tortilla chips and let the fun begin!
